name: cargo-tracker-e2e
description: E2E tests for Cargo Tracker using Playwright

scripts.lint:no-networkidle: ! grep -rn "networkidle\|waitForTimeout" src 2>/dev/null || (echo '⛔ networkidle / waitForTimeout は flakiness 源のため禁止。waitForResponse / waitForSelector / locator.waitFor を使用してください（IT3 タスク 0.15）' && exit 1)
